#title: "CLMM model with emmeans and effect sizes"

# Data processing and analysis

## Load libraries and data

```{r load_data, echo=FALSE}

rm(list=ls(all = TRUE))


library(readxl)
library(magrittr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(ordinal)
library(RVAideMemoire)
library(emmeans)


# data in current working directory
score_df <- read_excel("all_data.xlsx", sheet = "Todas PrePost x8")
score_df <- score_df %>% rename("Score"="ScorePrePost")

# make Score>=1 (Likert-style) for emmeans results to match Score values!!!
# (not needed if differences or slopes are considered only)
#score_df$Score <- score_df$Score - min(score_df$Score, na.rm=TRUE) + 1


```

### Summarise data for plotting

```{r summarise_data, echo=FALSE}

# set level order
levels_T <- c("Pre","Post")
levels_S <- c("Low","High")
levels_Q <- c("Comparison","Measurement","Rational","Esoteric")

# mean across participants, keep 3 factors
score_df_mean <- score_df %>%
  group_by(Treatment, SES, Question) %>%
  summarise(Score_ave=mean(Score, na.rm=TRUE),
            Score_ci=1.96*sd(Score, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            .groups="keep")
# set as factors and relevel for ggplot
score_df_mean$Treatment <- factor(score_df_mean$Treatment, levels=levels_T)
score_df_mean$Question <- factor(score_df_mean$Question, levels=levels_Q)
score_df_mean$SES <- factor(score_df_mean$SES, levels=levels_S)

# Pre data only, mean across participants, keep factors SES and Question
score_pre_df <- score_df %>% filter(Treatment=="Pre")
score_pre_df_mean <- score_pre_df %>%
  group_by(SES, Question) %>%
  summarise(Score_ave=mean(Score, na.rm=TRUE),
            Score_ci=1.96*sd(Score, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            .groups="keep")
# set as factors and relevel for ggplot
score_pre_df_mean$Question <- factor(score_pre_df_mean$Question, levels=levels_Q)
score_pre_df_mean$SES <- factor(score_pre_df_mean$SES, levels=levels_S)

# Pre and Post data
# mean across participants and Question, keep factors Treatment and SES
score_df_mean_TS <- score_df %>%
  group_by(Treatment,SES) %>%
  summarise(Score_ave=mean(Score, na.rm=TRUE),
            Score_ci=1.96*sd(Score, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            .groups="keep")
# set as factors and relevel for ggplot
score_df_mean_TS$Treatment <- factor(score_df_mean_TS$Treatment, levels=levels_T)
score_df_mean_TS$SES <- factor(score_df_mean_TS$SES, levels=levels_S)

# mean across participants and SES, keep factors Treatment and Question
score_df_mean_TQ <- score_df %>%
  group_by(Treatment, Question) %>%
  summarise(Score_ave=mean(Score, na.rm=TRUE),
            Score_ci=1.96*sd(Score, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            .groups="keep")
# set as factors and relevel for ggplot
score_df_mean_TQ$Treatment <- factor(score_df_mean_TQ$Treatment, levels=levels_T)
score_df_mean_TQ$Question <- factor(score_df_mean_TQ$Question, levels=levels_Q)

# mean across participants and Treatment, keep factors SES and Question

  group_by(SES, Question) %>%
  summarise(Score_ave=mean(Score, na.rm=TRUE),
            Score_ci=1.96*sd(Score, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            .groups="keep")
# set as factors and relevel for ggplot
score_df_mean_QS$Question <- factor(score_df_mean_QS$Question, levels=levels_Q)
score_df_mean_QS$SES <- factor(score_df_mean_QS$SES, levels=levels_S)


# keep Question only
score_df_mean_Q <- score_df %>%
  group_by(Question) %>%
  summarise(Score_ave=mean(Score, na.rm=TRUE),
            Score_ci=1.96*sd(Score, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            .groups="keep")
# set as factors and relevel for ggplot
score_df_mean_Q$Question <- factor(score_df_mean_Q$Question, levels=levels_Q)

# keep SES only
score_df_mean_S <- score_df %>%
  group_by(SES) %>%
  summarise(Score_ave=mean(Score, na.rm=TRUE),
            Score_ci=1.96*sd(Score, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n()),
            .groups="keep")
# set as factors and relevel for ggplot

# keep Treatment only
```

```{r plot_summarised_data, echo=FALSE}

score_df_mean$Question <- factor(score_df_mean$Question,levels = c("Measurement", "Comparison", "Esoteric", "Rational"))

plot_3factors <- score_df_mean %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Question, y=Score_ave, color=Treatment, linetype=SES,
             group=interaction(Treatment,SES))) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(x=Question, ymin=Score_ave-Score_ci,

  scale_linetype_discrete(labels=c('Low-SES', 'High-SES')) +

  labs(subtitle='',
```

### Rearrange levels and factors for fitting and contrasts

```{r df_as_factors, echo=FALSE}

# define variables as factors for clmm and relevel for contrasts
score_df$Score <- as.factor(score_df$Score)
score_df$SES <- factor(score_df$SES, levels=c("High","Low"))
score_df$Treatment <- factor(score_df$Treatment, levels=c("Post","Pre"))
score_df$Question <- factor(score_df$Question, levels=levels_Q)

score_pre_df <- score_df %>% filter(Treatment=="Pre")

```

### Fit model to Pre data

#Pre data: "describing the tool"


#### Linear regression

#Both SES and Question and their interaction have significant effects:
```{r clmm_model_fit_pre, echo=FALSE}

# fit model to "Pre" data
model_clmm_pre <- clmm(Score ~ SES + Question
                       + SES:Question
                       + (1|Participant), data = score_pre_df)
model_clmm_pre_anova <- Anova.clmm(model_clmm_pre, type="II")
# show main effects
model_clmm_pre_anova

```


#### Efect sizes

# Effect of SES: High gets better scores than Low (difference=3.05)
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# main effect of SES
model_clmm_pre_emm_S <- emmeans(model_clmm_pre, ~ SES, infer=c(TRUE,TRUE), mode="mean.class")
#pairs(model_clmm_pre_emm, typr="response", infer=c(TRUE,TRUE), adjust="tukey")
contrast(model_clmm_pre_emm_S, "pairwise", infer=c(TRUE,TRUE), adjust="tukey")
#test(pairs(model_clmm_pre_emm, type="response", infer=c(TRUE,TRUE), adjust="tukey"))
```

# Effect of Question: some questions are more difficult than others. Measurement is easier than Comparison (i.e. it gets higher scores: difference=0.695), Rational and Esoteric are both easier than Measurement (differences 1.3208 and 1.3956, respectively) and show no significant differences between them.
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# main effect of Question
model_clmm_pre_emm_Q <- emmeans(model_clmm_pre, ~ Question,
                                infer=c(TRUE,TRUE), mode="mean.class")
#pairs(model_clmm_pre_emm, typr="response", infer=c(TRUE,TRUE), adjust="tukey")
contrast(model_clmm_pre_emm_Q, "consec", infer=c(TRUE,TRUE), adjust="mvt")

```

#Means of every cell:
#(WARNING emmeans backtransforms scores to the interval [1:max], NOT the original score scale; this only matters when considering absolute scores, not score differences)
```{r, echo=FALSE}

# cell means and CIs
# "mean.class" option for getting results transformed back to the "response" scale (not logit scale)
model_clmm_pre_emm_cells <- emmeans(model_clmm_pre, ~ SES*Question,
                                    infer=c(TRUE,TRUE), mode="mean.class", adjust="mvt")
# WARNING emmeans backtransforms scores to the interval [1:max], NOT the original score scale
model_clmm_pre_emm_cells

```

### Fit model of complete data

#### Linear regression

#Full model vs reduced model: (may take a long time)
```{r clmm_model_fit_full, echo=FALSE}

# Model up to 1st-order interactions
# Score ~ (SES + Question + Treatment)^2
model_clmm_2order <- clmm(Score ~ SES + Question + Treatment
                          + SES:Question + SES:Treatment + Question:Treatment
                          + (1|Participant), data = score_df)

model_clmm_2order_anova <- Anova.clmm(model_clmm_2order, type="II")
model_clmm_2order_anova


# full model
# Score ~ (SES + Question + Treatment)^3
model_clmm_full <- clmm(Score ~ SES + Question + Treatment
                        + SES:Question + SES:Treatment + Question:Treatment
                        + SES:Treatment:Question
                        + (1|Participant), data = score_df)

model_clmm_full_anova <- Anova.clmm(model_clmm_full, type="II")
model_clmm_full_anova


# model comparison
# original (simpler) model is preferred because there is no significant difference between them
anova(model_clmm_2order,model_clmm_full)


```


#### Efect sizes

#Main effect of Treatment: on average, Post gets better scores than Pre (difference=1.19)
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# main effect of Treatment
model_clmm_2order_emm_T <- emmeans(model_clmm_2order, ~ Treatment, infer=c(TRUE,TRUE), mode="mean.class")
contrast(model_clmm_2order_emm_T, "pairwise", infer=c(TRUE,TRUE), adjust="tukey")

```

#Main effect of SES: on average, High gets better scores than Low (difference=2.99)
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# main effect of SES
model_clmm_2order_emm_S <- emmeans(model_clmm_2order, ~ SES, infer=c(TRUE,TRUE), mode="mean.class")
contrast(model_clmm_2order_emm_S, "pairwise", infer=c(TRUE,TRUE), adjust="tukey")

```



#Non-significant interaction between Treatment and SES: LowSES improvement is slightly higher (0.938) than HighSES (0.733) (need to use full model)
```{r}
# post-hoc comparisons
model_clmm_2order_emm_ST <- emmeans(model_clmm_2order, ~ SES:Treatment)
# contrasts (post-hoc comparisons)
model_clmm_2order_emm_ST_pairs <- pairs(model_clmm_2order_emm_ST, infer=c(TRUE,TRUE), simple="Treatment")
model_clmm_2order_emm_ST_test <- test(model_clmm_2order_emm_ST_pairs, cross.adjust="fdr", type="response")
# compute confidence intervals
model_clmm_2order_emm_ST_test_CI <- model_clmm_2order_emm_ST_test %>%
  mutate(LCI = estimate - 1.96*SE,
         UCI = estimate + 1.96*SE)
print(model_clmm_2order_emm_ST_test)


```


# Effect of Question: some questions are more difficult than others. Measurement is easier than Comparison (i.e. it gets higher scores: difference=0.695), Rational and Esoteric are both easier than Measurement (differences 1.3208 and 1.3956, respectively) and show no significant differences between them.
```{r, echo=FALSE}
# main effect of Question
model_clmm_2order_emm_Q <- emmeans(model_clmm_2order, ~ Question,
                                   infer=c(TRUE,TRUE), mode="mean.class")
#pairs(model_clmm_pre_emm, typr="response", infer=c(TRUE,TRUE), adjust="tukey")
contrast(model_clmm_2order_emm_Q, "consec", infer=c(TRUE,TRUE), adjust="mvt")

```



#Interaction between Treatment and Question: all questions have greater scores in Post, but some more than others. For instance, Comparison improves 1.26 points after Treatment while Rational only improves 0.501 points.
```{r}
# post-hoc comparisons
model_clmm_2order_emm_QT <- emmeans(model_clmm_2order, ~ Question:Treatment)
# contrasts (post-hoc comparisons)
model_clmm_2order_emm_QT_pairs <- pairs(model_clmm_2order_emm_QT, infer=c(TRUE,TRUE), simple="Treatment")
model_clmm_2order_emm_QT_test <- test(model_clmm_2order_emm_QT_pairs, cross.adjust="fdr", type="response")
# compute confidence intervals
model_clmm_2order_emm_QT_test_CI <- model_clmm_2order_emm_QT_test %>%
  mutate(LCI = estimate - 1.96*SE,
         UCI = estimate + 1.96*SE)
print(model_clmm_2order_emm_QT_test)

```



#Interaction between SES and Question: 
```{r}
# post-hoc comparisons
model_clmm_2order_emm_QS <- emmeans(model_clmm_2order, ~ Question:SES)
# contrasts (post-hoc comparisons)
model_clmm_2order_emm_QS_pairs <- pairs(model_clmm_2order_emm_QS, infer=c(TRUE,TRUE), simple="SES")
model_clmm_2order_emm_QS_test <- test(model_clmm_2order_emm_QS_pairs, cross.adjust="fdr", type="response")
# compute confidence intervals
model_clmm_2order_emm_QS_test_CI <- model_clmm_2order_emm_QS_test %>%
  mutate(LCI = estimate - 1.96*SE,
         UCI = estimate + 1.96*SE)
print(model_clmm_2order_emm_QS_test)

```
